notes: All 7 web searches ran this time (the 6 required plus one on the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act). The official-site search returned only the AI-WISE Act releases (28 October 2025, 18 November 2025, 20 January 2026), a committee assignment release (Digital Assets, Financial Technology, and Artificial Intelligence Subcommittee) and the 13 August 2025 'Evening Edition: The Role of Coal in the AI Era' item, which does not quote Downing on AI (it paraphrases Montana Republicans saying coal is needed for AI energy demand). The searches on superintelligence, extinction or existential risk, pause or slowdown, China agreement and 'AI safety' returned no results mentioning Downing. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (House sponsor Rep. Casar): cosponsor lists found (Forkast, FastDemocracy H.R. 10538) name only Democrats and do not include Downing; Congress.gov was not checked directly. No House letter on AI risk led by Downing was found. The AI-WISE statement and record were kept from the earlier attempt, which opened downing.house.gov press release listing pages 1 to 8 and the AI-WISE release directly (the AI-WISE quote was read at source).
